analyst.summary: Wockhardt has genuinely turned around operationally -- from a loss in FY25 to a Rs 199 Cr profit in FY26 with improving margins each quarter -- and carries a long-standing, differentiated pipeline in novel antibiotics that could be a meaningful longer-term value driver if it converts to approved, marketed products. At the current price, however, the stock already trades at more than 100 times trailing earnings, a multiple the underlying return on equity (~6%) does not yet support, and quarterly results have been volatile (a loss as recently as June 2025). We would treat this as a Sell for portfolio purposes on valuation grounds, notwithstanding the improving underlying trend.
